title: Conditional Inversion
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has dominado la Inversión Condicional, una de las estructuras gramaticales más sofisticadas y elegantes del inglés. Tu nivel escrito ahora es digno de publicaciones literarias y documentos legales de alto nivel.

parts.visual:
En inglés extremadamente formal (contratos, literatura, discursos), podemos eliminar la palabra 'If' en las oraciones condicionales haciendo una Inversión (sujeto y verbo intercambian lugar). 

1. Primer Condicional (Usando 'Should'): 
- Normal: If you need any help, please contact me. 
- Inversión: SHOULD YOU need any help, please contact me. 
- Negativo: Should you NOT receive the package, call us. 

2. Segundo Condicional (Usando 'Were'): 
- Normal: If I were the CEO, I would fire him. 
- Inversión: WERE I the CEO, I would fire him.
parts.audio: Welcome to Conditional Inversion. In extremely formal English, such as legal contracts or high-level speeches, we can completely remove the word 'If' from conditional sentences by using inversion. Number 1: The First Conditional using 'Should'. Normal sentence: If you need any help, please contact me. Inverted: SHOULD YOU need any help, please contact me. If it's negative: Should you NOT receive the package, call us. Number 2: The Second Conditional using 'Were'. Normal: If I were the CEO, I would fire him. Inverted: WERE I the CEO, I would fire him.

parts.visual:
Más sobre el Segundo Condicional con verbos normales (se usa 'Were + sujeto + to + verbo'): 
- Normal: If she asked me, I would say yes. 
- Inversión: WERE SHE TO ask me, I would say yes. 

3. Tercer Condicional (Usando 'Had'): 
- Normal: If I had known the truth, I wouldn't have signed. 
- Inversión: HAD I KNOWN the truth, I wouldn't have signed. 
- Normal: If the bank had failed, the economy would have collapsed. 
- Inversión: HAD THE BANK FAILED, the economy would have collapsed. 
- Negativo: HAD WE NOT intervened, they would be bankrupt.
parts.audio: Let's look closer at the Second Conditional with normal verbs. We use 'Were plus subject plus to plus base verb'. Normal: If she asked me, I would say yes. Inverted: WERE SHE TO ask me, I would say yes. Number 3: The Third Conditional using 'Had'. This is the most common conditional inversion. Normal: If I had known the truth, I wouldn't have signed. Inverted: HAD I KNOWN the truth, I wouldn't have signed. Another example. Normal: If the bank had failed, the economy would have collapsed. Inverted: HAD THE BANK FAILED, the economy would have collapsed. And in the negative: HAD WE NOT intervened, they would be bankrupt.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta de inversión condicional.

questions.question: Normal: If you require further assistance, let us know. -> Inversión: ____ you require further assistance, let us know.
Normal: If I had seen the email, I would have replied. -> Inversión: ____ the email, I would have replied.
questions.explanation: Had I seen (reemplaza 'If I had seen').

questions.question: Normal: If he were in charge, things would be different. -> Inversión: ____ in charge, things would be different.
questions.explanation: Were he in charge (reemplaza 'If he were in charge').

questions.question: Normal: If the CEO resigned, the stock would crash. -> Inversión con Were...to: ____ resign, the stock would crash.
questions.explanation: Were the CEO to resign (reemplaza 'If the CEO resigned').

questions.question: Normal: If you don't receive the payment by Friday, call my lawyer. -> Negativo: ____ receive the payment by Friday, call my lawyer.
questions.explanation: Should you not receive... (nunca usamos la contracción shouldn't en inversiones formales).

questions.question: Normal: If we hadn't invested early, we would be poor now. -> Negativo: ____ invested early, we would be poor now.
Normal: If she should decide to sell, we will buy. -> Inversión: ____ to sell, we will buy.
Normal: If I had known about the fraud, I would have gone to the police. -> Inversión: ____ about the fraud, I would have gone to the police.
Normal: If it rained tomorrow, we would cancel the event. -> Inversión: ____ tomorrow, we would cancel the event.
questions.explanation: Were it to rain (If it rained).

questions.question: Normal: If anyone asks, tell them I'm out. -> Inversión: ____, tell them I'm out.
Normal: If the alarm hadn't rung, we would have died. -> Negativo: ____ rung, we would have died.
Normal: If the government should increase taxes, the company will relocate. -> Inversión: ____ taxes, the company will relocate.
Normal: If I were a rich man, I wouldn't work. -> Inversión: ____ a rich man, I wouldn't work.
Normal: If you need to contact me, call this number. -> Inversión: ____ to contact me, call this number.
Normal: If they had offered more money, I would have accepted. -> Inversión: ____ more money, I would have accepted.
Normal: If the market were to crash, we would lose everything. -> Inversión: ____ crash, we would lose everything.
Negativo de Were: Normal: If I weren't so tired, I would go. -> Inversión: ____ so tired, I would go.
questions.explanation: Were I not so tired (sin contracción).

questions.question: ¿Cuál de estas oraciones está ESCRITA INCORRECTAMENTE?
options: Shouldn't you arrive on time, we will leave.
Should you not arrive on time, we will leave.
Had he not lied, he wouldn't be in jail.
Were she to fail, she would try again.
questions.correct_answer: Shouldn't you arrive on time, we will leave.
questions.explanation: En las inversiones formales negativas, NO usamos contracciones con el auxiliar. Lo correcto es 'Should you not'.

questions.question: Normal: If the project had been delayed, we would have lost the client. -> Inversión pasiva: ____ delayed, we would have lost the client.
Normal: If she called me today, I would be surprised. -> Inversión: ____ today, I would be surprised.
questions.explanation: Were she to call me (2º condicional con verbo regular).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa la inversión condicional sin usar 'If'.

questions.question: ____ you need help, call me. (Si llegaras a necesitar)
____ I the CEO, I would fire him. (Si yo fuera)
____ I known the truth, I would have left. (Si hubiera sabido)
Should you ____ receive it, let us know. (Si NO lo recibes)
Were she ____ ask me, I would say yes. (Si ella me pidiera)
____ they offered more, I would have signed. (Si hubieran ofrecido)
Had we ____ intervened, they would be dead. (Si NO hubiéramos intervenido)
____ anyone ask, tell them I'm busy. (Si alguien pregunta)
Were I ____ so tired, I would go. (Si NO estuviera)
____ the project been delayed, we would have lost. (Si el proyecto hubiera sido)
